summary: Eightco Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Master Services Agreement with ARK Capital Markets LLC for strategic and business advisory services over at least five years. The agreement includes a 1.00% annual management fee on treasury assets under management, warrants to purchase up to 2,200,000 shares at $1.01 per share vesting quarterly over five years, and potential capitalization milestone bonuses. No transaction involving acquisition, divestiture, or change of control occurred; the filing describes a routine advisory service contract.
